slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the timing of purchases within a month. The closest question was about whether capacity applies to end-of-month or beginning-of-month inventory, which concerns inventory measurement timing, not when purchases occur relative to sales.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month before sales, as implied by the inventory balance I_t = I_{t-1} + x_t - s_t and the sales feasibility constraint s_t ≤ I_{t-1} + x_t.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked or received confirmation about the intra-month timing of purchases; it silently adopted beginning-of-month purchases in the READY_TO_MODEL formulation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month remained unresolved and was silently assumed.

summary: The agent clarified several useful modeling details but failed to ask about the timing of purchases within each month, silently assuming beginning-of-month purchases in its final formulation. This leaves a P1 hidden slot unresolved at READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
